page_title: COS 2-4 GER | Costa Rica v Germany 01/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+10' Jamal Musiala (Germany) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Keylor Navas allowed him to make a comfortable save.
90+8' Ronald Matarrita (Costa Rica) sends a cross into the box, but Manuel Neuer comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+7' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

90+7' Jamal Musiala (Germany) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Germany will have a corner.
90+6' Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
90+4' The attendance is 67054.
90+3' The substitution is prepared. Matthias Ginter (Germany) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Niklas Sule.
90+3' Yeltsin Tejeda goes off the pitch and Roan Wilson (Costa Rica) comes on.
90+3' Luis Fernando Suarez prepares a substitution. Bryan Oviedo is replaced by Anthony Contreras (Costa Rica).
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 4 Goal! Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Leroy Sane. The score is 2:4.
89' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Stephanie Frappart is going to take a look using VAR.
89' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
87' Mario Gotze (Germany) gets to a rebound and attempts to score with a header. Keylor Navas is in the right place at the right time and keeps out the effort which was heading under the crossbar.
87' A tremendous drive by Kai Havertz (Germany) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Keylor Navas makes a brilliant save.

85' 2 - 3 It's a goal! Kai Havertz (Germany) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Serge Gnabry. The score is 2:3.
84' Jamal Musiala (Germany) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
83' Ronald Matarrita (Costa Rica) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
79' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
79' Antonio Rudiger (Germany) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort. Germany get a corner.
79' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
77' Oscar Duarte (Costa Rica) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
77' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Germany) is cleared.

76' Niclas Fullkrug (Germany) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Keylor Navas shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
74' Here is a change. Keysher Fuller Spence is going off and Luis Fernando Suarez gives the last tactical orders to Jewison Bennette (Costa Rica).
74' Here comes a substitution. Ronald Matarrita (Costa Rica) is brought on as a substitute for Johan Venegas.
73' 2 - 2 GOAL! Kai Havertz (Germany) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Keylor Navas, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:2.

70' Juan Pablo Vargas (Costa Rica) determinedly makes his way to the ball from the resulting set piece, but only manages to connect with his body. It's enough to beat the goalkeeper, however, and make it 2:1.
70' Lukas Klostermann (Germany) trips an opposition player and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
67' Jamal Musiala (Germany) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
66' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Mario Gotze (Germany) replaces David Raum.
66' Today's match ends for Thomas Muller who will be replaced by Kai Havertz (Germany).
65' A cross by David Raum (Germany) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
63' Post! Antonio Rudiger (Germany) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
62' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
62' Thomas Muller (Germany) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
61' Jamal Musiala (Germany) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Yeltsin Tejeda (Costa Rica) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:1.
58' Manuel Neuer makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Kendall Jamaal Waston Manley (Costa Rica) after a cross from the side.
56' A short pass finds Leroy Sane (Germany). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
55' Germany failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ilkay Gundogan trots off the pitch and is replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (Germany).
54' Leroy Sane (Germany) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Lukas Klostermann collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
54' A quickly taken corner by Germany.
53' Jamal Musiala (Germany) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Germany.
52' Wow, what an escape. Keysher Fuller Spence (Costa Rica) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
51' Johan Venegas (Costa Rica) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
50' Keysher Fuller Spence (Costa Rica) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
48' Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
48' Thomas Muller (Germany) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
46' The game is over for Leon Goretzka. Lukas Klostermann (Germany) comes on for the second half.
46' Luis Fernando Suarez makes a switch. Youstin Salas (Costa Rica) is coming on in place of Brandon Aguilera at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Stephanie Frappart starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' The resulting corner comes to nothing as David Raum (Germany) sends it out of play.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Leroy Sane (Germany) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
44' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
44' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) whips in a cross from the corner, but Manuel Neuer is well positioned and punches the ball away.

43' Keysher Fuller Spence (Costa Rica) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Manuel Neuer inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the roof of the net, but was denied by a great save.
42' Jamal Musiala (Germany) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
40' Serge Gnabry (Germany) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
39' David Raum (Germany) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

39' Germany slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
36' Jamal Musiala (Germany) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post.

35' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Keylor Navas!
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Raum (Germany).
32' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
31' Leroy Sane (Germany) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Keylor Navas, who smothers the ball.
30' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from David Raum (Germany). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

30' That's unlucky! Serge Gnabry (Germany) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Germany.
29' Bryan Oviedo (Costa Rica) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
28' David Raum (Germany) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
27' Serge Gnabry (Germany) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Germany have a corner.
26' Jamal Musiala (Germany) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
26' A pass into the penalty area from David Raum (Germany) is intercepted by the defence.
25' Jamal Musiala (Germany) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Thomas Muller, but Keylor Navas displays great awareness to stop him.
24' 29:71 – the latest ball possession ratio.
21' David Raum (Germany) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
20' Serge Gnabry (Germany) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Germany force their opponents to concede a corner.
20' Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) jumps into a tackle and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul.
19' Brandon Aguilera (Costa Rica) is flagged for offside.
17' Johan Venegas (Costa Rica) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
17' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Keysher Fuller Spence (Costa Rica).
15' David Raum (Germany) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

14' Leon Goretzka (Germany) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Keylor Navas, who pulls off a stunning save!
13' Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
13' Ilkay Gundogan (Germany) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
12' Serge Gnabry (Germany) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

10' 0 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from David Raum finds Serge Gnabry (Germany), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Keylor Navas had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.
9' Joshua Kimmich picks out Thomas Muller (Germany) on the edge of the six-yard box, but the headed attempt bends just round the right post.
8' Johan Venegas (Costa Rica) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
8' Jamal Musiala (Germany) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
6' David Raum (Germany) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
5' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Serge Gnabry (Germany) offside.
3' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

3' Jamal Musiala (Germany) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Keylor Navas made a comfortable save.
1' Thomas Muller (Germany) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stephanie Frappart saw the whole situation.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Germany will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart will supervise the game today.
